purpose: Retest 4 versus16 incoming ACK buffers on a 4.5ms routed delay-only path.
method: Persistent daemons within each phase; fresh namespaces between phases. Disjoint CPU placement, no overlapping local builds, kernel tests or Git packing. CPU covers before/sent samples; 100% is one core. Goodput uses receiver sample bytes/time; final missing and counter deltas include two-second drain. Gauges are absolute per-worker after values, never counter deltas. Zero phase has no netem qdisc. Qdisc-left affects R-to-L; qdisc-right affects L-to-R. Production/candidate/production order.
candidate: Only ACK_BUFFERS changes4→16. Incoming/outgoing capacities and accounted startup storage follow this bound.
disposition: Not adopted: fewer ACK drops and higher5G goodput, but forward0.5G below both controls and forward unlimited below closing control. Further delayed-path repeats needed before acceptance.
counter_units: Queue drops count source buffers or control records; a dropped GSO source can contain many frames. TAP and socket drops count SKBs, expiry counts frame classes. Do not sum them as exact frame losses.
